citations.cites: Exclusion E-61 Water damage from a burst supply line occurring while the dwelling is unoccupied between tenancies for more than 30 consecutive days
Clause 4 Landlord duties – inspection within 7 days of tenancy ending

facts: Burst supply line under kitchen sink at rental property on 2024-10-08.
Unit was empty for 45 days after tenant moved out on 2024-08-24.
Landlord shut off water at the main and drained the lines the week the tenant left.
Landlord inspected the unit on 2024-09-13, more than 7 days after tenancy ended.
note: The loss is a burst supply line occurring while the dwelling was unoccupied for 45 days, matching exclusion E-61. [DP-0703_02-24#05] Although the landlord shut off the water and drained the system, the required inspection within 7 days after tenancy ended was not performed, voiding the exception. [DP-0703_02-24#06] Accordingly, the exclusion appears to apply. [DP-0703_02-24#05]
